**Error from my 3% price increase on 2026-10-14**

The catalog check flagged that I applied the 3% increase to 22 fixed-price contract products (P-1201 to P-1222). They should have been excluded. Eight orders placed since then (SO-77310 to SO-77317) were billed at the increased prices, for a total overcharge of 4,128.60.

I have not changed any prices. Proposed fix:
1. Revert the 22 products to their pre-increase prices.
2. Credit or correct the eight affected orders, for Sales or Finance to approve.

Should I go ahead with the revert? I can also notify Lena Ortiz, since the increase was made at her request.
